vi.hero_lead: Khi agent có quyền đọc file, chạy shell, sửa code và ship PR, một dòng dặn trong prompt là chưa đủ. Cần một lớp kiểm tra trước khi tool thật sự chạy.
vi.intro_title: Một task nhỏ, nhiều quyền quá rộng
vi.intro_p1: Bạn giao cho agent một việc nhỏ: sửa validation trong một module. Nó muốn chắc hơn nên quét thêm vài thư mục, mở file config nhạy cảm, rồi tiện tay gom luôn vài cleanup không liên quan vào cùng một PR.
vi.intro_p2: Nhìn qua thì mọi thứ vẫn ổn. Test vẫn pass. Nhưng context đã lẫn file rác, secret có thể đã đi vào transcript (toàn bộ bản ghi hội thoại giữa bạn và agent), còn review thì bị loãng vì phần cần sửa và phần "tiện tay" nằm chung một PR.
vi.intro_bad_3: Cleanup ngoài scope — review bị loãng
vi.intro_bad_4: Test pass nên làm tiếp — thiếu bước kiểm tra scope
vi.intro_good_3: Scope lệch — rule/hard-gate nhắc quay lại task chính
vi.intro_good_4: Trước khi ship — simplify/review gate kiểm tra lại diff
vi.intro_pull: Agent không tự nhiên cẩn thận hơn. Chỉ là trước khi nó làm gì đó, có một lớp đứng ra hỏi: việc này có nên được phép chạy không?
vi.intro_key_p: Guard rail không làm model thông minh hơn. Nó kiểm tra hành động trước khi tool chạy. Rule, hard-gate và guard skill là các lớp định hướng thêm, hữu ích nhưng vẫn phụ thuộc model hoặc user có gọi hay không.
vi.s1_title: Guard rail là gì trong agentic coding
vi.s1_p1: Guard rail là lớp đứng giữa agent và hành động: việc rủi ro thì chặn, việc đáng nghi thì cảnh báo. Nó giống lan can ở mép cầu thang: không làm bạn đi giỏi hơn, nhưng giảm khả năng một cú bước hụt thành tai nạn. Khác với lời dặn trong prompt, tức prompt instruction, guard rail chạy ở tầng điều phối tool, không phụ thuộc model có "nhớ" hay không.
vi.s1_h3: Phân biệt guard rail và lời dặn
vi.s2_title: Guard rail hoạt động thế nào
vi.s2_p1: Harness là lớp runtime bọc quanh model. Model chỉ quyết định "tôi muốn đọc file này" hoặc "tôi muốn chạy lệnh này"; harness mới là bên nhận tool call, quản quyền, gọi hook, cho tool chạy hoặc chặn, rồi trả kết quả lại cho model. Hook là script nhỏ harness tự gọi tại các thời điểm cố định trong vòng đời một tool call — lúc nhận prompt, trước tool, sau tool — để xen vào kiểm tra. Vì mọi hành động thật đều qua harness, đây là chỗ gắn guard rail.
vi.s2_refline: Đọc thêm nền khái niệm: Harness Engineering là gì? của Duy /zuey/.
vi.s2_hooks_guide_before: Chi tiết ClaudeKit Hooks có thể xem thêm tại
vi.s2_flow_aria: Vòng đời một tool call qua guard rail
vi.s2_svgnote: Hook không nằm trong model. Nó nằm ở lifecycle của Claude Code: settings.json quyết định hook nào được gọi, .ck.json/ENV quyết định runtime behavior, còn output của hook có thể cho chạy, chặn, inject context hoặc ghi state/artifact sau khi tool hoặc session kết thúc.
vi.s2_h3_flow: Flow một tool call qua guard rail
vi.s2_flow_p: Điểm mấu chốt: pre-tool hook trả exit code. Exit 0 cho tool chạy, exit 2 chặn và đẩy lý do về model. Ba điểm chèn chính trong flow có tên kỹ thuật tương ứng: UserPromptSubmit (lúc nhận prompt), PreToolUse (trước tool), PostToolUse (sau tool). Riêng Stop/SubagentStop chạy khi session hoặc subagent kết thúc, nên nằm ở bản đồ lifecycle phía trên.
vi.s2_exit_p: Exit code là số process trả về khi kết thúc. Claude Code đọc nó để quyết tool có chạy không:
vi.s2_exit_li1: exit 0 — OK, tool chạy. stdout đọc làm JSON output.
vi.s2_exit_li2: exit 2 — chặn. Bỏ stdout, đẩy stderr về model làm thông báo lỗi.
vi.s2_exit_li3: exit 1 (hoặc mã khác) — lỗi nhưng KHÔNG chặn. Báo lỗi rồi tool vẫn chạy tiếp.
vi.s2_exit_end: Chỉ exit 2 mới chặn thật. Hook muốn enforce policy phải dùng đúng exit 2 — dùng nhầm exit 1 theo thói quen Unix là guard tưởng bật mà thực ra mở.
vi.s2_hard_p: Hook exit 2, tool không chạy. Nhưng hook crash → Claude Code cho qua (fail-open). Bug ở hook làm guard tắt âm thầm.
vi.s2_soft_p: Thêm text vào context (rule, hard-gate). Model phải tự tuân. Mạnh hay yếu phụ thuộc model.
vi.s2_benefit_1: Giữ context sạch · giữ secret khỏi transcript
vi.s2_benefit_3: Chặn sớm trước khi rủi ro lan ra — agent định đọc .env, quét quá rộng, hoặc kéo cleanup ngoài scope vào PR
vi.s2_benefit_4: Nhiều lớp bù nhau — hook có thể fail-open, rule có thể bị model bỏ qua, guard skill có thể không được gọi; tách thành nhiều lớp giúp giảm phụ thuộc vào một điểm chặn duy nhất
vi.s3_title: Bảy nhóm guard rail trong CK
vi.s3_note_p: Sau một fresh CK install, file-access guard nằm ở PreToolUse hook như scout-block và privacy-block. Nếu phiên Claude Code đang chạy ở mode bỏ qua permission prompt, các hook này vẫn là lớp chặn chính của CK. Nhưng hook CK là fail-open: crash hoặc bị disable thì tool call có thể đi tiếp.

vi.s4_tag: Bản đồ config · nơi kiểm hook có thật sự chạy không
vi.s4_p1: Hai lớp config quyết định guard nào chạy: settings.json gắn hook vào lifecycle của Claude Code; .ck.json bật/tắt từng hook và chỉnh threshold.
vi.s4_h3_settings: settings.json: hook nào chạy ở mốc nào
vi.s4_settings_p: Snippet dưới đây chỉ minh hoạ một lát cắt PreToolUse trong fresh CK install: CK cung cấp scout-block và privacy-block, rồi wire chúng vào lifecycle để Claude Code gọi trước khi tool chạy. Full hook config trên máy đã cài còn nhiều lifecycle event hơn; nơi cần xem là settings.json của Claude Code.
vi.s4_settings_p2: settings.json là bản đồ lifecycle: khi user gửi prompt thì hook nào chạy, trước khi tool chạy thì hook nào được gọi, sau khi tool xong thì hook nào xử lý tiếp. Với global install, CLI đổi command tương đối trong template thành dạng node "$HOME/.claude/hooks/scout-block.cjs"; với project install, path thường giữ ở dạng .claude/hooks/....
vi.s4_3labels_p: Đừng gom mọi thứ thành "mặc định bật/tắt". Trạng thái của một hook có ba lớp khác nhau:
vi.s4_lbl_script: File .cjs có nằm trong .claude/hooks/. Có file chưa có nghĩa là hook đang chạy.
vi.s4_lbl_wired: settings.json đã gắn script vào lifecycle event của Claude Code. Không wire thì Claude Code không tự gọi hook đó.
vi.s4_lbl_runtime: Khi hook đã được gọi, code bên trong đọc .ck.json/DEFAULT_CONFIG/ENV để quyết định có chạy tiếp không. Một vài guard còn có công tắc con như privacyBlock hoặc simplify.gate.enabled.
vi.s4_16hooks_p: Bảng dưới đây liệt kê đủ 16 hook script top-level trong .claude/hooks/; không tính helper files nằm sâu trong subfolder.
vi.s4_hk_session_init_p: Project/env setup khi startup, resume, clear, compact.
vi.s4_hk_quota_p: Không đọc hook flag riêng; chạy khi được wire.
vi.s4_hk_simplify_p: Script được gọi, nhưng simplify.gate.enabled mặc định false.
vi.s4_hk_descname_p: Nhắc đặt tên file/script rõ nghĩa.
vi.s4_hk_scout_p: Chặn heavy dirs và glob quá rộng.
vi.s4_hk_plan_p: Không đọc hook flag riêng; warn format plan.
vi.s4_hk_sstate_m: PostToolUse · SubagentStop · Stop · runtime flag true
vi.s4_hk_cook_p: Không có key riêng trong DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks, nhưng isHookEnabled() chỉ tắt khi flag là false.
vi.s4_hk_wag_p: Opt-in cho artifact gate: cần wire hook và bật flag/gate config.
vi.s4_hk_teamctx_p: Không có key riêng trong DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks; chỉ có ý nghĩa khi workflow/team layer gọi tới.
vi.s4_hk_uca_p: Usage/context injection hook; không nằm trong settings.json template.
vi.s4_isHookEnabled_p: Điểm dễ sót: isHookEnabled() chỉ tắt khi hooks.<name> là false. Key thiếu thường được xem là enabled. Nhưng vài guard còn có công tắc riêng: privacy-block vẫn đọc key cũ privacyBlock=false, còn simplify-gate có simplify.gate.enabled và ENV CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1.
vi.s4_h3_manual: Manual bật/tắt và tự kiểm tra hook
vi.s4_manual_p: Muốn chỉnh nhanh, sửa .ck.json ở scope cần tác động. Project config ưu tiên hơn global khi key được set rõ; key thiếu thì tiếp tục inherit/default. Với các hook đã được wire trong settings.json, đặt false là tắt, đặt true là bật lại sau khi scope cao hơn đã tắt. Tên hook trong cột Hook bên dưới cũng là key dùng trong hooks.<name>.
vi.s4_do1_note: Hook script vẫn còn, nhưng runtime cho qua.
vi.s4_do2: Bật lại hook bị tắt ở global

vi.s4_do3_note: privacyBlock=false là key cũ nhưng vẫn có hiệu lực.
vi.s4_do4_note: Thiếu simplify.gate.enabled=true thì gate chưa bật chế độ chặn.
vi.s4_do5_note: Env override mạnh hơn config gate.
vi.s4_do6_note: Fresh install chưa wire sẵn, nên chỉ sửa .ck.json là chưa đủ.
vi.s4_trigger_p: Muốn biết hook có được trigger không, nhìn lifecycle event chứ không nhìn tên file. Cùng một hook script chỉ chạy khi event/matcher trong settings.json khớp với hành động hiện tại. Bảng dưới đây là cách kiểm nhanh từng hook; hook not wired cần wire trước hoặc gọi bằng manual CLI nếu script hỗ trợ.

vi.s5_title: scout-block — chặn đọc thư mục rác
vi.s5_p1: Agent hay đọc node_modules/, glob **/*.ts ở root (glob là mẫu khớp đường dẫn; **/*.ts nghĩa là mọi file .ts ở mọi thư mục con), cat dist/index.js. Mỗi lần là vài chục nghìn token nhét vào context, kéo cost và chất lượng turn sau xuống. scout-block.cjs đăng ký PreToolUse, chạy trước mọi Read/Bash/Glob/Grep.
vi.s5_allow_p: Các lệnh build được cho qua. Những lệnh như npm build, go build, make, docker build vẫn chạy, kể cả khi quá trình build chạm node_modules hoặc dist. Nếu chặn cả nhóm này, các flow ship/test của CK dễ tự vấp ngay từ bước build.
vi.s5_gap1_p: Fail-open: parse error đều dẫn tới exit 0, tool được cho qua. Hook có bug → guard lớp đó tắt âm thầm.

vi.s6_title: privacy-block — chặn secret, bắt user duyệt rõ ràng
vi.s6_p1: Agent đụng .env, id_rsa, *.pem, credentials.yaml — secret lộ vào transcript. Một khi vào context, có thể bị log, quote lại trong reviewer output, paste vào PR.
vi.s6_p2: Claude parse JSON, gọi AskUserQuestion. Nếu user duyệt, hook message hướng dẫn đọc file bằng đường approved, ví dụ cat ".env" sau khi đã hỏi; code cũng hỗ trợ prefix APPROVED:. Điểm chính: phải có approval rõ ràng, không để model tự diễn dịch consent.
vi.s6_gap2_p: privacy-block cho Bash đi qua, chỉ cảnh báo. Bất kỳ ai có quyền chạy Bash đều đọc secret mà không qua approval flow.
vi.s6_incident_p: Privacy-block chỉ chặn READ. Rotate credential ngay, audit conversation log, check git history xem secret có bị commit không.
vi.s7_title: simplify-gate — chặn ship khi diff phình quá scope
vi.s7_p1: Một task nhỏ có thể phình ra thành PR đụng quá nhiều file: sửa validation, thêm cleanup, đổi format, chỉnh vài helper lân cận. Khi agent nói "OK ship", simplify-gate.cjs đăng ký UserPromptSubmit, đọc git diff HEAD, chỉ xét khi prompt có: ship merge pr deploy publish.
vi.s7_stats_note: Các ngưỡng mặc định của simplify.threshold: tổng dòng thêm+xóa, số file bị đụng, và dòng thêm lớn nhất trong một file. Gate chỉ chặn khi simplify.gate.enabled=true; các số này có thể override trong .ck.json.
vi.s7_gap3_p: hooks.simplify-gate = true chỉ cho Claude Code gọi script. Muốn script thật sự chặn PR phình quá scope, phải bật thêm simplify.gate.enabled = true. Fresh install chưa bật flag này, nên gate chỉ chạy kiểm tra nhẹ và không block.
vi.s7_p2: matchedSeverity() bỏ qua "don't ship", "ship on" → "ship on Friday" cũng đi qua. Muốn tắt gate cho mọi session ở scope đó, đặt CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1 trong settings.json dưới key env.
vi.s8_p1: Full pipeline → mỗi phase để lại file JSON ghi quyết định, như hoá đơn sau mỗi bước. Hook này được thiết kế để gắn vào UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Bash), nhưng không nằm trong hook set chạy sẵn sau fresh install; muốn dùng phải opt-in.
vi.s8_p2: Gate này có hai mức xử lý. Ở bước rủi ro như ship, push, PR hoặc deploy, hook có thể dừng flow ngay và trả lý do về cho model (emitBlock()). Ở bước nhẹ hơn như finalize hoặc commit, hook cho flow đi tiếp nhưng thêm cảnh báo vào context để model tự sửa (emitSoft()).
vi.s8_gap4_p: workflow-artifact-gate là lớp kiểm artifact mạnh nhất, nhưng fresh install chưa tự gọi nó. Muốn dùng, phải wire hook trong settings.json và bật config trong .ck.json; nếu thiếu bước này, ship/push/PR/deploy không bị gate chặn.
vi.s9_p1: Hook chỉ chặn tool call. Có lỗi không phải tool call mà là trình tự: code trước plan, fix trước scout. CK gắn <HARD-GATE> vào skill markdown.
vi.s9_p2: ck:cook và ck:fix mỗi skill có 4 hard-gate (plan/scout-first, exact-req hoặc root-cause, no-side-effects).
vi.s9_why_p: Chữ "hard" dễ hiểu nhầm — không phải chặn bằng code. Là lời dặn trong prompt. Model bỏ qua → không có exit 2 chặn. Cách bọc XML tạo signal mạnh hơn rule thường để model khó hợp lý hoá việc đi tắt.
vi.s10_p1: dev-rules-reminder.cjs đăng ký UserPromptSubmit, đưa rules text vào mỗi prompt. Ở đây có hai lớp cần tách rõ: hook là cơ chế inject context, còn rule trong CLAUDE.md là nội dung được inject. TTL 5 phút theo (sessionId, baseDir) để tránh đốt token.
vi.s10_common_p: Rules là text trong context, không phải code. Claude có thể lệch nếu prompt user đè. Bù lại rất dễ thêm/sửa. Phù hợp quy ước phong cách hơn guard bảo mật.

en.page_desc: When an agent has permission to read files, run shell commands, edit code, and ship PRs, a single line of instruction in the prompt is not enough. You need a check layer before the tool actually runs.
en.hero_kick: Inside ClaudeKit · Guard rails deep dives
en.hero_title: Guard rails: the brake layer between model and action
en.hero_lead: When an agent has permission to read files, run shell commands, edit code, and ship PRs, a single line of instruction in the prompt is not enough. You need a check layer before the tool actually runs.
en.intro_title: A small task, far too many permissions
en.intro_p1: You give the agent a small task: fix validation in a module. To be safe it scans a few extra directories, opens a sensitive config file, then conveniently bundles some unrelated cleanup into the same PR.
en.intro_p2: At first glance everything looks fine. Tests still pass. But context has been polluted with junk files, secrets may have entered the transcript (the complete record of the conversation between you and the agent), and the review is diluted because the intended change and the "convenient" additions sit in the same PR.
en.intro_bad_3: Cleanup out of scope — review diluted
en.intro_bad_4: Tests pass so work continues — no scope check step
en.intro_good_3: Scope drift — rule/hard-gate redirects back to main task
en.intro_good_4: Before shipping — simplify/review gate re-checks diff
en.intro_pull: The agent doesn't naturally become more careful. It's just that before it does anything, there is a layer that asks: should this action be allowed to run?
en.intro_key_lead: Hooks are the real blocking layer.
en.intro_key_p: Guard rails don't make the model smarter. They check actions before the tool runs. Rules, hard-gates, and guard skills are additional orientation layers — useful, but still dependent on whether the model or user invokes them.
en.s1_title: What are guard rails in agentic coding
en.s1_p1: A guard rail is the layer that stands between the agent and an action: blocking risky operations, warning on suspicious ones. It is like a railing on the edge of a staircase: it doesn't make you walk better, but it reduces the chance that a misstep becomes an accident. Unlike instructions in the prompt, i.e. prompt instructions, guard rails run at the tool-orchestration layer and do not depend on the model "remembering" them.
en.s2_p1: Harness is the runtime layer wrapping the model. The model only decides "I want to read this file" or "I want to run this command"; it is the harness that receives the tool call, manages permissions, invokes hooks, lets the tool run or blocks it, then returns the result to the model. Hooks are small scripts the harness calls at fixed points in a tool call's lifecycle — on prompt receipt, before a tool, after a tool — to intervene and check. Because every real action goes through the harness, this is where guard rails attach.
en.s2_refline: For conceptual background, read: What is Harness Engineering? by Duy /zuey/.
en.s2_hooks_guide_before: For more detail on ClaudeKit Hooks, see
en.s2_flow_aria: Lifecycle of a tool call through guard rails
en.s2_svgnote: Hooks do not live inside the model. They live in Claude Code's lifecycle: settings.json decides which hooks are called, .ck.json/ENV decides runtime behavior, and hook output can allow, block, inject context, or write state/artifacts after a tool or session ends.
en.s2_h3_flow: Flow of a tool call through guard rails
en.s2_flow_p: The key point: a pre-tool hook returns an exit code. Exit 0 lets the tool run; exit 2 blocks and pushes the reason back to the model. The three main injection points in the flow have corresponding technical names: UserPromptSubmit (on prompt receipt), PreToolUse (before a tool), PostToolUse (after a tool). Stop/SubagentStop run when a session or subagent ends, so they appear on the lifecycle map above.
en.s2_exit_p: An exit code is the number a process returns when it exits. Claude Code reads it to decide whether a tool runs:
en.s2_exit_li1: exit 0 — OK, tool runs. stdout is read as JSON output.
en.s2_exit_li2: exit 2 — block. Discard stdout, push stderr back to the model as an error message.
en.s2_exit_li3: exit 1 (or other codes) — error but does NOT block. Reports the error and the tool still runs.
en.s2_exit_end: Only exit 2 actually blocks. A hook that wants to enforce policy must use exit 2 precisely — accidentally using exit 1 out of Unix habit means the guard appears to be on but is actually open.
en.s2_hard_p: Hook exits 2, tool does not run. But if the hook crashes, Claude Code lets it through (fail-open). A bug in a hook silently disables that guard.
en.s2_soft_p: Adds text to context (rule, hard-gate). The model must comply on its own. Strength depends on the model.
en.s2_benefit_1: Keeps context clean · keeps secrets out of transcript
en.s2_benefit_2: Keeps the rhythm: plan → simplify → review
en.s2_benefit_3: Blocks early before risk spreads — agent about to read .env, scan too broadly, or pull out-of-scope cleanup into a PR
en.s2_benefit_4: Multiple layers compensate for each other — a hook can fail-open, a rule can be ignored by the model, a guard skill may not be called; splitting into multiple layers reduces dependence on a single blocking point
en.s3_title: Seven guard rail groups in CK
en.s3_note_p: After a fresh CK install, file-access guards live in PreToolUse hooks such as scout-block and privacy-block. If the Claude Code session is running with permission prompts suppressed, these hooks are still CK's primary blocking layer. But CK hooks are fail-open: if they crash or are disabled, the tool call may proceed.

en.s4_tag: Config map · where to verify a hook is really running
en.s4_p1: Two config layers determine which guards run: settings.json attaches hooks to Claude Code's lifecycle; .ck.json enables/disables individual hooks and adjusts thresholds.
en.s4_h3_settings: settings.json: which hook runs at which point
en.s4_settings_p: The snippet below illustrates just one slice of PreToolUse from a fresh CK install: CK provides scout-block and privacy-block, then wires them into the lifecycle so Claude Code calls them before a tool runs. The full hook config on an installed machine has more lifecycle events; the place to check is Claude Code's settings.json.
en.s4_settings_p2: settings.json is the lifecycle map: which hook runs when the user submits a prompt, which is called before a tool runs, which handles things after a tool finishes. For a global install the CLI rewrites relative commands in the template to the form node "$HOME/.claude/hooks/scout-block.cjs"; for a project install, paths usually stay as .claude/hooks/....
en.s4_h3_3labels: Reading the hook table with 3 labels
en.s4_3labels_p: Don't collapse everything into "on by default / off by default". The state of a hook has three distinct layers:
en.s4_lbl_script: The .cjs file exists in .claude/hooks/. Having the file does not mean the hook is running.
en.s4_lbl_wired: settings.json has attached the script to a Claude Code lifecycle event. Without wiring, Claude Code never calls that hook.
en.s4_lbl_runtime: Once the hook is called, the code inside reads .ck.json/DEFAULT_CONFIG/ENV to decide whether to proceed. Some guards also have sub-switches such as privacyBlock or simplify.gate.enabled.
en.s4_16hooks_p: The table below lists all 16 top-level hook scripts in .claude/hooks/; helper files deeper in subfolders are not counted.
en.s4_hk_session_init_p: Project/env setup on startup, resume, clear, compact.
en.s4_hk_quota_p: Does not read its own hook flag; runs when wired.
en.s4_hk_simplify_p: Script is called, but simplify.gate.enabled defaults to false.
en.s4_hk_scout_p: Blocks heavy dirs and overly broad globs.
en.s4_hk_plan_p: Does not read its own hook flag; warns on plan format.
en.s4_hk_sstate_m: PostToolUse · SubagentStop · Stop · runtime flag true
en.s4_hk_cook_p: No dedicated key in DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks, but isHookEnabled() only disables when the flag is false.
en.s4_hk_wag_p: Opt-in for artifact gate: hook must be wired and flag/gate config must be enabled.
en.s4_hk_teamctx_p: No dedicated key in DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks; only meaningful when the workflow/team layer calls it.
en.s4_hk_uca_p: Usage/context injection hook; not in settings.json template.
en.s4_isHookEnabled_p: Easy to miss: isHookEnabled() only disables when hooks.<name> is false. A missing key is usually treated as enabled. But some guards also have their own switches: privacy-block still reads the legacy key privacyBlock=false, while simplify-gate has simplify.gate.enabled and ENV CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1.
en.s4_manual_p: For quick adjustments, edit .ck.json at the scope you want to affect. Project config takes priority over global when a key is explicitly set; missing keys continue to inherit/default. For hooks already wired in settings.json, setting false turns them off; setting true re-enables them after a higher scope has disabled them. The hook name in the Hook column is also the key used in hooks.<name>.
en.s4_do1_note: Hook script remains, but runtime lets it through.
en.s4_do3_note: privacyBlock=false is the legacy key but still takes effect.
en.s4_do4_note: Without simplify.gate.enabled=true, the gate's blocking mode is not active.
en.s4_do5_note: Env override is stronger than config gate.
en.s4_do6_note: Fresh install does not wire it by default, so editing .ck.json alone is not enough.
en.s4_trigger_p: To know whether a hook gets triggered, look at the lifecycle event, not the file name. The same hook script only runs when the event/matcher in settings.json matches the current action. The table below is a quick-check for each hook; not wired hooks need to be wired first, or called via manual CLI if the script supports it.
en.s4_tr_session: Open, resume, clear, or compact a Claude Code session.
en.s4_tr_quota: Open a session, send a new prompt, or update a Task/Todo.
en.s4_tr_quota_n: Cache usage; does not read its own hook flag.
en.s4_tr_simplify: Send a prompt with ship/merge/pr/deploy/publish intent when diff is large enough.
en.s4_tr_simplify_n: Requires simplify.gate.enabled=true; does not block by default.
en.s4_tr_subinit: Start a subagent via Task/agent flow.
en.s4_tr_descname: Let Claude attempt to create a file with Write.
en.s4_tr_descname_n: PreToolUse(Write); prompts for a clear file name.
en.s4_tr_scout: Let Claude read node_modules, dist, or a too-broad glob.
en.s4_tr_privacy: Let Claude read .env, a key file, or a secret path.
en.s4_tr_plan: Let Claude Edit/Write/MultiEdit a plan file.
en.s4_tr_plan_n: PostToolUse; warns on format, does not read its own hook flag.
en.s4_tr_sstate: Update a Task/Todo, end a subagent, or end a turn.
en.s4_tr_wag: Wire into UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse(Bash), or run the script with --stage.
en.s4_tr_wag_n: Fresh install does not auto-trigger hook mode.
en.s4_tr_taskc: Complete a task in Agent Teams.
en.s4_tr_idle: Let a teammate in Agent Teams finish their work and go idle.
en.s4_tr_teamctx: Wire into SubagentStart, then start a team subagent.
en.s4_tr_teamctx_n: Script is meaningful when the agent id belongs to a team.
en.s4_tr_uca: Wire into the desired event, or use the hook cache refresh already wired.
en.s4_tr_uca_n: Legacy wrapper around usage quota cache refresh.
en.s5_title: scout-block — block reads of junk directories
en.s5_p1: Agents often read node_modules/, glob **/*.ts at root (glob is a path-matching pattern; **/*.ts means every .ts file in every subdirectory), or cat dist/index.js. Each time that's tens of thousands of tokens stuffed into context, driving up cost and degrading the quality of subsequent turns. scout-block.cjs registers PreToolUse and runs before every Read/Bash/Glob/Grep.
en.s5_allow_p: Build commands are allowed through. Commands such as npm build, go build, make, docker build still run, even when the build process touches node_modules or dist. Blocking this group would cause CK's ship/test flows to stumble at the build step.
en.s5_gap1_p: Fail-open: parse errors all result in exit 0, letting the tool through. A bug in the hook silently disables that guard layer.
en.s6_title: privacy-block — block secrets, require explicit user approval
en.s6_p1: Agent touches .env, id_rsa, *.pem, credentials.yaml — secrets leak into the transcript. Once in context, they can be logged, quoted in reviewer output, or pasted into a PR.
en.s6_p2: Claude parses JSON and calls AskUserQuestion. If the user approves, the hook message instructs reading the file through an approved path, e.g. cat ".env" after asking; the code also supports the APPROVED: prefix. The key point: explicit approval is required — the model must not be allowed to self-interpret consent.
en.s6_gap2_p: privacy-block lets Bash through, only warning. Anyone with permission to run Bash can read secrets without going through the approval flow.
en.s6_incident_t: Warning: if a leak has already occurred
en.s6_incident_p: Privacy-block only blocks READs. Rotate the credential immediately, audit conversation logs, check git history to see whether the secret was committed.
en.s7_title: simplify-gate — block shipping when diff has ballooned past scope
en.s7_p1: A small task can balloon into a PR touching too many files: fix validation, add cleanup, change formatting, tweak a few nearby helpers. When the agent says "OK ship", simplify-gate.cjs registers UserPromptSubmit, reads git diff HEAD, and only acts when the prompt contains: ship merge pr deploy publish.
en.s7_stats_note: Defaults from simplify.threshold: total added+removed lines, touched-file count, and the largest added-line count in one file. The gate only blocks when simplify.gate.enabled=true; these values can be overridden in .ck.json.
en.s7_gap3_t: Gap #3 — default is easy to misread
en.s7_gap3_p: hooks.simplify-gate = true only tells Claude Code to call the script. To have the script actually block PRs that have ballooned past scope, you must also enable simplify.gate.enabled = true. A fresh install does not set this flag, so the gate only does a light check and does not block.
en.s7_p2: matchedSeverity() skips "don't ship" and "ship on" → "ship on Friday" also passes through. To disable the gate for all sessions at that scope, set CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1 in settings.json under the env key.
en.s8_p1: Full pipeline → each phase leaves a JSON file recording its decisions, like a receipt after every step. This hook is designed to attach to UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Bash), but is not in the hook set that runs out of the box after a fresh install; you must opt in to use it.
en.s8_p2: This gate has two processing levels. At high-risk steps such as ship, push, PR, or deploy, the hook can stop the flow immediately and return the reason to the model (emitBlock()). At lighter steps such as finalize or commit, the hook lets the flow continue but injects a warning into context for the model to self-correct (emitSoft()).
en.s8_gap4_p: workflow-artifact-gate is the strongest artifact-checking layer, but a fresh install does not call it automatically. To use it, wire the hook in settings.json and enable the config in .ck.json; without this step, ship/push/PR/deploy is not gated.
en.s9_p1: Hooks only block tool calls. Some failures are not tool calls but sequence errors: coding before planning, fixing before scouting. CK embeds <HARD-GATE> in skill markdown.
en.s9_p2: ck:cook and ck:fix each have 4 hard-gates (plan/scout-first, exact-req or root-cause, no-side-effects).
en.s9_why_p: The word "hard" is easy to misread — it does not block via code. It is an instruction in the prompt. If the model ignores it, there is no exit 2 to block. The XML wrapping creates a stronger signal than a plain rule, making it harder for the model to rationalize taking a shortcut.
en.s10_p1: dev-rules-reminder.cjs registers UserPromptSubmit and injects rules text into every prompt. Two layers need to be distinguished here: the hook is the context-injection mechanism, while the rules in CLAUDE.md are the content being injected. TTL is 5 minutes keyed on (sessionId, baseDir) to avoid burning tokens.
en.s10_r3_a: Two agents editing the same file
en.s10_common_p: Rules are text in context, not code. Claude can drift if the user's prompt overrides them. On the other hand, they are very easy to add and edit. Better suited to style conventions than security guards.
en.s11_tag: Guard group · Guard skill invoked by user
en.s11_title: Guard skills — guard layers the user invokes
en.s11_s1_c: Secret, CVE, SQLi, XSS, path traversal
en.s11_s4_c: Stop on test fail, never force-push
en.s11_p1: code-reviewer agent runs a 9-item checklist: concurrency, error boundary, API contract, backwards compat, input validation, auth/authz, N+1, data leak, fact-check. Final guard before merge.
en.s12_g1: File-access guard lives in hooks → fresh CK install relies on scout-block/privacy-block, not a separate permissions.deny list for secrets/heavy dirs
en.s12_g2: Bash is exempt from privacy-block → only warns, does not go through approval flow
en.s12_g3: workflow-artifact-gate requires opt-in → the strongest gate does not run unless enabled
en.s12_g4: simplify-gate does not block by default → must be explicitly enabled
en.s12_g5: simplify-gate can be slipped with phrasing → "ship on Friday" is ignored
en.s12_g8: HARD-GATE XML is also an instruction → has "User override"
en.s12_norate_p: An out-of-control agent can call thousands of Read/Glob/Bash operations. CK hooks do not count tool calls and do not self-stop when quota is nearly exhausted. Quota/cost limits live in Claude Code, the provider, or account billing — not in these guard rails.
en.s13_bp3: To have simplify-gate actually block: set gate.enabled = true
en.s13_bp4: Need node_modules: override with a project .ckignore

en.s13_pit2: Assuming simplify-gate is blocking, when the blocking mode is off by default
en.s13_pit3: Assuming a hook error means the tool will be blocked; in practice a failing hook usually lets it through
en.s13_pit4: Assuming a rule in the prompt blocks the same way a code hook does
en.s13_pit5: Relying on privacy-block to save you after a secret has already entered a commit
en.s13_h3_6q: 6 questions to ask before trusting a guard rail
en.s13_q1: Which hooks is settings.json currently attaching to which lifecycle events?
en.s13_q2: Which hooks has .ck.json disabled? (outer + inner config)
en.s13_q3: Is the current Claude Code session running with permission prompts suppressed?
en.s13_q4: Is there a project .ckignore override? Is node_modules !-allowlisted?
en.s13_q5: Are rule files in CLAUDE.md complete?
en.s13_q6: Has any hook crashed silently in this session (check stderr)?
en.gloss_harness: The orchestration layer between model and machine: sends tool commands, manages permissions, runs hooks. Where guard rails attach.
en.gloss_hook: A small script the harness calls at fixed points in the prompt/tool/session lifecycle to intercept, check, or write state.
en.gloss_lifecycle: The points where hooks are called: UserPromptSubmit (prompt received), PreToolUse (before tool), PostToolUse (after tool), Stop/SubagentStop (session/subagent ends).
en.gloss_exitcode: The number a process returns on exit. 0 allows, 2 blocks, 1 reports an error but does not block.
en.gloss_failopen: When a hook errors/crashes, the harness lets the tool run instead of blocking. Guard silently disables.
en.gloss_transcript: The complete record of the conversation between the user and the agent in a session.
en.gloss_context: The information space the model "sees" when reasoning. Full of junk files → higher cost, lower quality.
en.gloss_glob: A path-matching pattern. **/*.ts = every .ts file in every subdirectory.
en.gloss_secret: Sensitive information: API keys, private keys, credentials. Leaking into the transcript is a risk.
en.gloss_loc: Lines of code — line count, used to measure diff size.
en.gloss_artifact: JSON file each pipeline phase leaves behind, recording its decisions for the next phase to check.
en.closing_title: Read the right layer, trust to the right degree
en.closing_p1: When an agent has broad permissions, don't conclude "CK is installed so we're safe". Before trusting a guard rail, check two places: which hooks settings.json is wiring, and what .ck.json is enabling or disabling.
en.closing_p2: Each layer protects against a different kind of risk: hooks block tool calls, rules nudge behavior, hard-gates hold the workflow, guard skills only run when invoked. Knowing which layer is running and which is just an instruction helps you audit the right place — before a bug slips into a PR and makes it to PROD.

zh.intro_key_p: Guard rail 不会让模型变得更聪明。它在 tool 运行前检查行为。Rule、hard-gate 和 guard skill 是额外的引导层，有用但仍依赖模型或用户是否调用。
zh.s1_title: agentic coding 中 guard rail 是什么
zh.s1_p1: Guard rail 是介于 agent 与操作之间的一层：有风险的操作予以拦截，可疑的操作发出警告。它就像楼梯边缘的护栏：不会让你走得更好，但能降低踩空变成事故的概率。与 prompt 中的提示语（prompt instruction）不同，guard rail 运行在工具调度层，不依赖模型是否「记住」。
zh.s1_h3: 区分 guard rail 与提示语
zh.s1_r1_i: 在 context 内，由模型读取
zh.s2_p1: Harness 是包裹模型的运行时层。模型只决定「我想读这个文件」或「我想执行这条命令」；harness 才是接收 tool call、管理权限、调用 hook、决定让 tool 运行或拦截、并将结果返回给模型的一方。Hook 是 harness 在 tool call 生命周期的固定时间点自动调用的小脚本——收到 prompt 时、tool 执行前、tool 执行后——用于介入检查。由于所有真实操作都经过 harness，这里是挂载 guard rail 的地方。
zh.s2_refline: 概念背景延伸阅读：Duy /zuey/ 的 Harness Engineering là gì?。
zh.s2_hooks_guide_before: ClaudeKit Hooks 的更多细节可见
zh.s2_flow_aria: 一次 tool call 经过 guard rail 的生命周期
zh.svg_toolexec_sub: 读取 / 写入 / 实际运行
zh.s2_svgnote: Hook 不在模型内部。它位于 Claude Code 的生命周期中：settings.json 决定调用哪些 hook，.ck.json/ENV 决定运行时行为，hook 的输出可以允许运行、拦截、注入 context，或在 tool 或 session 结束后写入 state/artifact。
zh.s2_h3_flow: 一次 tool call 经过 guard rail 的流程
zh.s2_flow_p: 关键点：pre-tool hook 返回 exit code。Exit 0 允许 tool 运行，exit 2 拦截并将原因推送给模型。流程中三个主要介入点有对应的技术名称：UserPromptSubmit（收到 prompt 时）、PreToolUse（tool 执行前）、PostToolUse（tool 执行后）。Stop/SubagentStop 在 session 或 subagent 结束时运行，因此位于上方的生命周期映射图中。
zh.s2_exit_p: Exit code 是进程结束时返回的数字。Claude Code 通过它决定 tool 是否运行：
zh.s2_exit_li1: exit 0——正常，tool 运行。stdout 作为 JSON output 读取。
zh.s2_exit_li2: exit 2——拦截。丢弃 stdout，将 stderr 推送给模型作为错误消息。
zh.s2_exit_li3: exit 1（或其他代码）——报错但不拦截。报告错误后 tool 仍继续运行。
zh.s2_exit_end: 只有 exit 2 才是真正的拦截。想要 enforce policy 的 hook 必须使用 exit 2——按 Unix 习惯误用 exit 1 会导致 guard 看似开启实则放行。
zh.s2_hard_p: Hook exit 2，tool 不运行。但 hook crash 时 → Claude Code 放行（fail-open）。Hook 有 bug 会导致 guard 静默关闭。
zh.s2_soft_p: 向 context 添加文本（rule、hard-gate）。模型需自行遵守。强弱取决于模型。
zh.s2_benefit_1: 保持 context 干净 · 防止 secret 进入 transcript
zh.s2_benefit_3: 在风险扩散前早期拦截——agent 准备读取 .env、扫描范围过宽，或将 scope 外的 cleanup 拉入 PR
zh.s2_benefit_4: 多层互补——hook 可能 fail-open，rule 可能被模型忽略，guard skill 可能未被调用；分散为多层可降低对单一拦截点的依赖
zh.s3_title: CK 中的七类 guard rail
zh.s3_note_p: 全新 CK 安装后，文件访问 guard 位于 PreToolUse hook，如 scout-block 和 privacy-block。若当前 Claude Code session 以跳过权限提示的模式运行，这些 hook 仍是 CK 的主要拦截层。但 CK 的 hook 是 fail-open 的：crash 或被禁用时，tool call 可能照常通过。

zh.s4_tag: Config 映射图 · 验证 hook 是否真正运行
zh.s4_p1: 两层 config 决定哪些 guard 运行：settings.json 将 hook 挂载到 Claude Code 的生命周期；.ck.json 逐个启用/禁用 hook 并调整 threshold。
zh.s4_h3_settings: settings.json：哪些 hook 在哪个时间点运行
zh.s4_settings_p: 以下片段仅展示全新 CK 安装中 PreToolUse 的一个切面：CK 提供 scout-block 和 privacy-block，并将它们连接到生命周期，以便 Claude Code 在 tool 运行前调用。已安装机器上的完整 hook config 包含更多生命周期事件；需要查看的地方是 Claude Code 的 settings.json。
zh.s4_settings_p2: settings.json 是生命周期映射：用户发送 prompt 时调用哪个 hook，tool 运行前调用哪个 hook，tool 完成后由哪个 hook 继续处理。全局安装时，CLI 会将模板中的相对命令替换为 node "$HOME/.claude/hooks/scout-block.cjs" 形式；项目安装时，路径通常保持 .claude/hooks/... 形式。
zh.s4_h3_3labels: 按 3 个标签读取 hook 表格
zh.s4_3labels_p: 不要把所有内容归为「默认开启/关闭」。一个 hook 的状态有三个不同层面：
zh.s4_lbl_script: .cjs 文件是否位于 .claude/hooks/。有文件不代表 hook 正在运行。
zh.s4_lbl_wired: settings.json 已将脚本挂载到 Claude Code 的生命周期事件。未 wire 则 Claude Code 不会自动调用该 hook。
zh.s4_lbl_runtime: 当 hook 被调用时，内部代码读取 .ck.json/DEFAULT_CONFIG/ENV 来决定是否继续执行。部分 guard 还有子开关，如 privacyBlock 或 simplify.gate.enabled。
zh.s4_16hooks_p: 下表列出 .claude/hooks/ 中所有 16 个顶层 hook 脚本；不含深层子目录中的 helper 文件。
zh.s4_hk_session_init_p: 启动、恢复、clear、compact 时的项目/环境初始化。
zh.s4_hk_quota_p: 不读取独立 hook flag；wire 后即运行。
zh.s4_hk_simplify_p: 脚本被调用，但 simplify.gate.enabled 默认为 false。
zh.s4_hk_descname_p: 提示为文件/脚本取有意义的名称。
zh.s4_hk_scout_p: 拦截重型目录和过宽的 glob。
zh.s4_hk_privacy_p: 拦截 secret 路径，请求 approval。
zh.s4_hk_plan_p: 不读取独立 hook flag；警告 plan 格式。
zh.s4_hk_sstate_m: PostToolUse · SubagentStop · Stop · runtime flag true
zh.s4_hk_cook_p: DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks 中无独立 key，但 isHookEnabled() 仅在 flag 为 false 时禁用。
zh.s4_hk_wag_p: artifact gate 需 opt-in：须 wire hook 并启用 flag/gate config。
zh.s4_hk_teamctx_p: DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooks 中无独立 key；仅在 workflow/team 层调用时有意义。
zh.s4_hk_uca_p: Usage/context injection hook；不在 settings.json 模板中。
zh.s4_isHookEnabled_p: 容易忽略的点：isHookEnabled() 只在 hooks.<name> 为 false 时禁用。缺少 key 通常被视为 enabled。但部分 guard 还有独立开关：privacy-block 仍读取旧 key privacyBlock=false，simplify-gate 有 simplify.gate.enabled 和 ENV CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1。
zh.s4_h3_manual: 手动启用/禁用与 hook 自检
zh.s4_manual_p: 如需快速调整，在目标 scope 修改 .ck.json。当 key 明确设置时，项目 config 优先于全局；缺少 key 时继续 inherit/默认。对于已在 settings.json 中 wire 的 hook，设为 false 即禁用，设为 true 可在上层 scope 禁用后重新启用。Hook 列中的 hook 名称也是 hooks.<name> 中使用的 key。
zh.s4_do1: 禁用一个已 wire 的 hook
zh.s4_do1_note: Hook 脚本仍存在，但运行时放行。
zh.s4_do2: 重新启用已在 global 禁用的 hook
zh.s4_do2_note: 本地明确的 key 覆盖全局。
zh.s4_do4: 真正启用 simplify-gate 拦截
zh.s4_do4_note: 缺少 simplify.gate.enabled=true 则 gate 未开启拦截模式。
zh.s4_do5_note: ENV 覆盖优先于 config gate。
zh.s4_do6_note: 全新安装未预置 wire，仅修改 .ck.json 不够。
zh.s4_trigger_p: 想知道 hook 是否被触发，看生命周期事件而非文件名。同一 hook 脚本只有当 settings.json 中的 event/matcher 与当前操作匹配时才运行。下表是快速检查每个 hook 的方法；not wired 的 hook 需先 wire 或通过手动 CLI 调用（若脚本支持）。
zh.s4_tr_session: 打开、恢复、clear 或 compact Claude Code session。
zh.s4_tr_quota: 打开 session、发送新 prompt，或更新 Task/Todo。
zh.s4_tr_quota_n: 缓存用量；不读取独立 hook flag。
zh.s4_tr_simplify: 发送含 ship/merge/pr/deploy/publish 意图的 prompt，且 diff 足够大时。
zh.s4_tr_subinit: 通过 Task/agent flow 启动 subagent。
zh.s4_tr_descname: 让 Claude 通过 Write 创建文件。
zh.s4_tr_scout: 让 Claude 读取 node_modules、dist，或使用过宽的 glob。
zh.s4_tr_privacy: 让 Claude 读取 .env、key 文件、secret 路径。
zh.s4_tr_plan: 让 Claude 对 plan 文件执行 Edit/Write/MultiEdit。
zh.s4_tr_plan_n: PostToolUse；警告格式，不读取独立 hook flag。
zh.s4_tr_sstate: 更新 Task/Todo、结束 subagent，或结束当前 turn。
zh.s4_tr_wag: Wire 到 UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse(Bash)，或以 --stage 运行脚本。
zh.s4_tr_wag_n: 全新安装不会自动触发 hook 模式。
zh.s4_tr_taskc: 在 Agent Teams 中完成任务。
zh.s4_tr_idle: 让 Agent Teams 中的 teammate 完成工作并进入 idle 状态。
zh.s4_tr_teamctx: Wire 到 SubagentStart，然后启动 team subagent。
zh.s4_tr_teamctx_n: 当 agent id 属于 team 时脚本才有意义。
zh.s4_tr_uca: Wire 到目标事件，或使用已 wire 的 hook cache 刷新。
zh.s4_tr_uca_n: usage quota cache 刷新的遗留 wrapper。
zh.s5_tag: Guard 分组 · 文件/路径拦截
zh.s5_p1: Agent 经常读取 node_modules/、在根目录使用 **/*.ts glob（glob 是路径匹配模式；**/*.ts 表示所有子目录中的所有 .ts 文件）、cat dist/index.js。每次都会将数万 token 塞入 context，拉高成本并降低后续 turn 的质量。scout-block.cjs 注册 PreToolUse，在所有 Read/Bash/Glob/Grep 之前运行。
zh.s5_allow_p: 构建命令被放行。npm build、go build、make、docker build 等命令仍可运行，即使构建过程涉及 node_modules 或 dist。若拦截这类命令，CK 的 ship/test 流程很容易在构建阶段就自行卡住。
zh.s5_gap1_p: Fail-open：任何解析错误都会导致 exit 0，tool 被放行。Hook 有 bug → 该层 guard 静默关闭。
zh.s6_tag: Guard 分组 · 拦截敏感文件/路径
zh.s6_title: privacy-block——拦截 secret，强制用户明确审批
zh.s6_p1: Agent 接触 .env、id_rsa、*.pem、credentials.yaml——secret 会泄露进 transcript。一旦进入 context，可能被记录、在 reviewer output 中被引用，或粘贴到 PR 中。
zh.s6_p2: Claude 解析 JSON，调用 AskUserQuestion。若用户批准，hook 消息会引导通过已批准路径读取文件，例如在询问后执行 cat ".env"；代码也支持 APPROVED: 前缀。核心点：必须有明确的 approval，不能让模型自行解读 consent。
zh.s6_gap2_p: privacy-block 对 Bash 放行，仅发出警告。任何有 Bash 运行权限的人都可以不经 approval flow 直接读取 secret。
zh.s6_incident_p: Privacy-block 只拦截 READ。立即轮换凭证，审计对话日志，检查 git history 确认 secret 是否已被 commit。
zh.s7_tag: Guard 分组 · 拦截步骤错误
zh.s7_title: simplify-gate——当 diff 膨胀超出 scope 时拦截 ship
zh.s7_p1: 一个小任务可能膨胀成触及过多文件的 PR：修复 validation、添加 cleanup、改格式、调整几个相邻 helper。当 agent 说「OK ship」时，simplify-gate.cjs 注册 UserPromptSubmit，读取 git diff HEAD，仅在 prompt 包含以下内容时判断：ship merge pr deploy publish。
zh.s7_stats_note: simplify.threshold 的默认值：总新增+删除行数、触及文件数、单个文件中的最大新增行数。只有在 simplify.gate.enabled=true 时 gate 才会拦截；这些值可在 .ck.json 中覆盖。
zh.s7_gap3_p: hooks.simplify-gate = true 只是让 Claude Code 调用脚本。若要脚本真正拦截膨胀的 PR，还需启用 simplify.gate.enabled = true。全新安装未启用此 flag，因此 gate 只进行轻度检查，不会 block。
zh.s7_p2: matchedSeverity() 会忽略 "don't ship"、"ship on"——"ship on Friday" 也会通过。若要在该 scope 的所有 session 中关闭 gate，在 settings.json 的 env key 下设置 CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1。
zh.s8_tag: Guard 分组 · Workflow / artifact gate
zh.s8_p1: 完整 pipeline → 每个 phase 留下一个记录决策的 JSON 文件，如同每步之后的收据。此 hook 设计用于挂载到 UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Bash)，但不在全新安装后默认运行的 hook 集中；需要使用须 opt-in。
zh.s8_p2: 此 gate 有两种处理级别。在 ship、push、PR 或 deploy 等高风险步骤，hook 可立即停止流程并将原因返回给模型（emitBlock()）。在 finalize 或 commit 等较轻步骤，hook 让流程继续但向 context 添加警告供模型自行修正（emitSoft()）。
zh.s8_gap4_p: workflow-artifact-gate 是最强的 artifact 检查层，但全新安装不会自动调用它。使用前须在 settings.json 中 wire hook 并在 .ck.json 中启用 config；否则 ship/push/PR/deploy 不会被 gate 拦截。
zh.s9_title: Skill markdown 中的 Hard-gate XML
zh.s9_p1: Hook 只拦截 tool call。有一类错误不是 tool call，而是流程顺序：在 plan 前写代码，在 scout 前 fix。CK 在 skill markdown 中嵌入 <HARD-GATE>。
zh.s9_p2: ck:cook 和 ck:fix 各有 4 个 hard-gate（plan/scout-first、exact-req 或 root-cause、no-side-effects）。
zh.s9_why_p: 「hard」这个词容易误解——并非代码硬性拦截。它是 prompt 中的提示语。模型忽略时没有 exit 2 拦截。XML 包裹方式比普通 rule 产生更强的信号，使模型更难合理化跳过步骤的行为。
zh.s10_tag: Guard 分组 · 注入 context
zh.s10_p1: dev-rules-reminder.cjs 注册 UserPromptSubmit，将 rules 文本注入每个 prompt。这里需要区分两层：hook 是注入 context 的机制，而 CLAUDE.md 中的 rule 是被注入的内容。按 (sessionId, baseDir) 设置 5 分钟 TTL 以避免 token 消耗。
zh.s10_r1_a: audit 反转已确认的决策
zh.s10_r3_a: 两个 agent 同时编辑
zh.s10_common_p: Rules 是 context 中的文本，不是代码。若用户 prompt 覆盖，Claude 可能偏离。但易于添加/修改。更适合风格约定，而非安全性 guard。
zh.s11_tag: Guard 分组 · 用户调用的 guard skill
zh.s11_title: Guard skills——用户调用的 guard 层
zh.s11_s4_c: 测试失败即停止，永不 force-push
zh.s11_p1: code-reviewer agent 运行 9 项检查清单：并发、error boundary、API contract、向后兼容、输入验证、auth/authz、N+1、数据泄露、事实核查。合并前的最后一道 guard。
zh.s12_g1: 文件访问 guard 位于 hook——全新 CK 安装依赖 scout-block/privacy-block，而非针对 secret/重型目录的独立 permissions.deny 列表
zh.s12_g2: Bash 免于 privacy-block——仅警告，不经过 approval flow
zh.s12_g3: workflow-artifact-gate 需 opt-in——最强 gate 若未启用则不运行
zh.s12_g4: simplify-gate 默认未启用拦截——需明确启用
zh.s12_g5: simplify-gate 可被措辞绕过——「ship on Friday」被忽略
zh.s12_g6: .ckignore 可能 negate node_modules——直接检查确认
zh.s12_g7: Rules 是提示语——Claude 可能偏离
zh.s12_g8: HARD-GATE XML 也是提示语——存在「User override」
zh.s12_norate_p: 失控的 agent 可能调用数千次 Read/Glob/Bash。CK hook 不计数 tool call，不会在接近 quota 时自动停止。Quota/cost 限制由 Claude Code、provider 或账户计费决定，不在这层 guard rail 的职责范围内。
zh.s13_bp2: 生产环境仓库启用 workflow-artifact-gate
zh.s13_bp3: 要让 simplify-gate 真正拦截：设置 gate.enabled = true
zh.s13_bp5: 审批 .env：仔细阅读，不要自动确认
zh.s13_pit1: 修改了 global config，却以为在修改仓库的 config
zh.s13_pit2: 以为 simplify-gate 正在拦截，实际上默认未启用拦截模式
zh.s13_pit3: 以为 hook 报错会导致 tool 被拦截；实际上 hook 失败通常放行
zh.s13_pit4: 以为 prompt 中的 rule 也能像 code hook 一样拦截
zh.s13_pit5: Secret 已进入 commit 才寄望于 privacy-block 补救
zh.s13_h3_6q: 相信 guard rail 前的 6 个检查问题
zh.s13_q1: settings.json 当前将哪些 hook 挂载到哪些生命周期？
zh.s13_q2: .ck.json 禁用了哪些 hook？（outer + inner config）
zh.s13_q3: 当前 Claude Code session 是否在跳过权限提示的模式下运行？
zh.s13_q4: 是否有项目 .ckignore override？node_modules 是否被 ! 加入 allowlist？
zh.s13_q5: CLAUDE.md 中的 rule 文件是否齐全？
zh.s13_q6: 本 session 中是否有 hook 静默 crash（检查 stderr）？
zh.gloss_harness: 模型与机器之间的调度层：发送 tool 命令、管理权限、运行 hook。是挂载 guard rail 的地方。
zh.gloss_hook: Harness 在 prompt/tool/session 生命周期固定时间点自动调用的小脚本，用于介入检查或写入 state。
zh.gloss_lifecycle: Hook 被调用的时间点：UserPromptSubmit（收到 prompt）、PreToolUse（tool 执行前）、PostToolUse（tool 执行后）、Stop/SubagentStop（session/subagent 结束）。
zh.gloss_exitcode: 进程结束时返回的数字。0 放行，2 拦截，1 报错但不拦截。
zh.gloss_failopen: 当 hook 报错/crash 时，harness 让 tool 继续运行而非拦截。Guard 静默关闭。
zh.gloss_transcript: session 中用户与 agent 之间对话的完整记录。
zh.gloss_context: 模型推理时「看到」的信息区域。充斥无用文件 → 成本高、质量下降。
zh.gloss_glob: 路径匹配模式。**/*.ts = 所有子目录中的所有 .ts 文件。
zh.gloss_secret: 敏感信息：API key、private key、credential。泄露进 transcript 即为风险。
zh.gloss_loc: Lines of code——代码行数，用于衡量 diff 大小。
zh.gloss_artifact: 每个 pipeline phase 留下的 JSON 文件，记录决策供后续 phase 检查。
zh.closing_p1: 当 agent 拥有广泛权限时，不要下结论「安装了 CK 就安全了」。在相信 guard rail 之前，检查两处：settings.json 当前 wire 了哪些 hook，.ck.json 当前启用/禁用了什么。
zh.closing_p2: 每层防护针对一类风险：hook 拦截 tool call，rule 提示行为，hard-gate 维护流程，guard skill 仅在被调用时运行。了解哪层正在运行、哪层只是提示语，有助于在错误进入 PR 并流向 PROD 之前在正确的地方进行审计。

ja.intro_title: 小さなタスク、広すぎる権限
ja.intro_p1: エージェントに小さな作業を依頼しました：あるモジュールのバリデーションを修正する。より確実にしたいと判断したエージェントは追加でいくつかのディレクトリをスキャンし、センシティブなconfigファイルを開き、さらについでに無関係なcleanupもまとめて同じPRに含めました。
ja.intro_p2: 一見すると問題なさそうです。テストもpassしています。しかしcontextには不要なファイルが混入し、secretがtranscript（あなたとエージェントの会話の全記録）に入り込んだ可能性があり、修正すべき部分と「ついで」の部分が同じPRに混在しているためレビューが散漫になっています。

ja.intro_bad_3: スコープ外のcleanup — レビューが散漫になる
ja.intro_bad_4: テストがpassしたので続行 — スコープ確認ステップが欠如
ja.intro_good_3: スコープ逸脱 — rule/hard-gateがメインタスクへ戻るよう促す
ja.intro_good_4: ship前 — simplify/review gateがdiffを再確認
ja.intro_pull: エージェントは自然と慎重にはなりません。ただ、何かを実行しようとする前に、「これは実行を許可すべきか？」と問う層が立ちはだかるのです。
ja.intro_key_lead: Hookが本物のブロック層です。
ja.intro_key_p: Guard railはモデルをより賢くするわけではありません。ツールが実行される前にアクションを検査します。Rule、hard-gate、guard skillは追加の方向付け層であり有用ですが、モデルまたはユーザーが呼び出すかどうかに依存します。
ja.s1_title: agentic codingにおけるguard railとは
ja.s1_p1: Guard railはエージェントとアクションの間に立つ層です：リスクのある操作はブロックし、疑わしい操作は警告します。階段の端にある手すりのようなもので、歩き方が上手くなるわけではありませんが、一歩踏み外しても事故になる可能性を減らします。プロンプト内の指示（prompt instruction）と異なり、guard railはモデルが「覚えているか」に依存せず、ツール調整層で動作します。
ja.s1_r2_g: コードで実際にブロック
ja.s1_r2_i: モデルが自発的に従う
ja.s1_r3_i: 忘れやすい・スリップしやすい
ja.s1_r4_k: モデルが誤解した場合
ja.s1_r4_g: 引き続きブロック（クラッシュしなければ）
ja.s1_r5_g: コード・configの修正が必要
ja.s2_p1: Harnessはモデルを包むruntime層です。モデルは「このファイルを読みたい」または「このコマンドを実行したい」と決定するだけで、harnessがtool callを受け取り、権限を管理し、hookを呼び出し、ツールを実行またはブロックし、結果をモデルに返します。Hookは、検査や状態記録のために介入するため、harnessがtool callのライフサイクル（prompt受信時、tool前、tool後）の固定タイミングで自動的に呼び出す小さなスクリプトです。すべての実際のアクションがharnessを通過するため、guard railを組み込む場所はここです。
ja.s2_refline: 概念の背景についてはこちら：Duy /zuey/ による Harness Engineering とは？
ja.s2_flow_aria: guard railを通過するtool callのライフサイクル

ja.s2_svgnote: HookはモデルI内にはありません。Claude Codeのライフサイクルに位置します：settings.jsonがどのhookを呼び出すかを決定し、.ck.json/ENVがruntime behaviorを決定します。hookの出力は、実行を許可・ブロックし、contextをinjectし、ツールまたはセッション終了後にstate/artifactを記録できます。
ja.s2_h3_flow: guard railを通過するtool callのフロー
ja.s2_flow_p: 重要なポイント：pre-tool hookはexit codeを返します。Exit 0でツール実行、exit 2でブロックして理由をモデルへ送信。フロー内の3つの主要な介入ポイントには対応する技術名があります：UserPromptSubmit（prompt受信時）、PreToolUse（tool前）、PostToolUse（tool後）。Stop/SubagentStopはセッションまたはsubagent終了時に実行されるため、上のライフサイクルマップに示されています。
ja.s2_exit_p: Exit codeはプロセス終了時に返す数値です。Claude Codeはこれを読んでツールを実行するか決定します：
ja.s2_exit_li1: exit 0 — OK、ツール実行。stdoutをJSON outputとして読み取ります。
ja.s2_exit_li2: exit 2 — ブロック。stdoutを無視し、stderrをエラーメッセージとしてモデルへ送信。
ja.s2_exit_li3: exit 1（またはその他のコード）— エラーだがブロックしない。エラーを報告してもツールは続行します。
ja.s2_exit_end: exit 2だけが実際にブロックします。ポリシーを強制したいhookは必ずexit 2を使用してください。Unix習慣で誤ってexit 1を使うと、guard railがオンのつもりで実際にはオープンになります。
ja.s2_hard_p: Hook exit 2、ツール実行なし。ただしhookがクラッシュするとClaude Codeは通過させます（fail-open）。hookのバグがguardをサイレントに無効にします。
ja.s2_soft_p: contextにテキストを追加します（rule、hard-gate）。モデルが自発的に従う必要があります。強度はモデルに依存します。
ja.s2_benefit_1: contextをクリーンに保つ · secretをtranscriptから守る
ja.s2_benefit_2: リズムを維持：plan → simplify → review
ja.s2_benefit_3: リスクが広がる前に早期ブロック — エージェントが.envを読もうとする、広すぎるスキャン、スコープ外のcleanupをPRに引き込む
ja.s2_benefit_4: 複数の層が互いを補完 — hookがfail-openになる可能性があり、ruleをモデルが無視する可能性があり、guard skillが呼び出されない可能性がある。複数の層に分けることで単一のブロックポイントへの依存を減らします
ja.s3_note_p: freshなCKインストール後、file-access guardはscout-blockやprivacy-blockなどのPreToolUse hookに存在します。Claude Codeセッションがpermission promptをスキップするモードで動作している場合も、これらのhookはCKの主要なブロック層です。ただしCKのhookはfail-openです：クラッシュまたは無効化された場合、tool callはそのまま通過する可能性があります。

ja.s4_p1: どのguardが動作するかを決定する2つのconfig層：settings.jsonがhookをClaude Codeのライフサイクルに組み込み、.ck.jsonが各hookのオン・オフを切り替え、thresholdを調整します。
ja.s4_project_cmt: # プロジェクトスコープ
ja.s4_h3_settings: settings.json：どのhookがどのタイミングで動作するか
ja.s4_settings_p: 以下のsnippetはfreshなCKインストールにおけるPreToolUseの一断面のみを示しています：CKはscout-blockとprivacy-blockを提供し、ツール実行前にClaude Codeが呼び出せるようライフサイクルにwireします。インストール済み環境のfull hook configにはさらに多くのlifecycle eventがあります。確認すべき場所はClaude Codeのsettings.jsonです。
ja.s4_settings_p2: settings.jsonはlifecycleマップです：ユーザーがpromptを送信したときにどのhookが動作するか、ツール実行前にどのhookが呼び出されるか、ツール完了後にどのhookが処理を続けるか。グローバルインストールの場合、CLIはテンプレート内の相対コマンドをnode "$HOME/.claude/hooks/scout-block.cjs"形式に変換します。プロジェクトインストールの場合、pathは通常.claude/hooks/...形式のままです。
ja.s4_h3_3labels: 3つのラベルでhookテーブルを読む
ja.s4_3labels_p: すべてを「デフォルトでオン・オフ」と単純化しないでください。hookの状態には3つの異なる層があります：
ja.s4_lbl_script: .cjsファイルが.claude/hooks/に存在します。ファイルが存在するだけではhookが動作しているとは言えません。
ja.s4_lbl_wired: settings.jsonがスクリプトをClaude CodeのLifecycle eventに組み込んでいます。wireしていないとClaude Codeはそのhookを自動呼び出ししません。
ja.s4_lbl_runtime: hookが呼び出された後、内部のコードが.ck.json/DEFAULT_CONFIG/ENVを読んで実際に処理を続けるか決定します。privacyBlockやsimplify.gate.enabledなどのサブスイッチを持つguardもあります。
ja.s4_16hooks_p: 以下のテーブルには.claude/hooks/内の上位16のhookスクリプトをすべて列挙しています。サブフォルダ内のhelperファイルは含みません。
ja.s4_hk_session_init_p: 起動・再開・クリア・compactのプロジェクト・環境セットアップ。
ja.s4_hk_quota_p: hook flagは個別に読み取らない。wireされたときに動作。
ja.s4_hk_simplify_p: スクリプトは呼び出されますが、simplify.gate.enabledはデフォルトでfalse。
ja.s4_hk_descname_p: ファイル・スクリプトに分かりやすい名前をつけるよう促します。
ja.s4_hk_scout_p: 重いディレクトリと広すぎるglobをブロックします。
ja.s4_hk_privacy_p: secretパスをブロックし、approvalを求めます。
ja.s4_hk_plan_p: hook flagは個別に読み取らない。planフォーマットについて警告。
ja.s4_hk_sstate_m: PostToolUse · SubagentStop · Stop · runtime flag true
ja.s4_hk_sstate_p: session・taskの状態を記録します。
ja.s4_hk_cook_p: DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooksに個別keyはないが、isHookEnabled()はflagがfalseのときのみ無効化。
ja.s4_hk_wag_p: artifact gateのopt-in：hookのwireとflag・gate configの有効化が必要。
ja.s4_hk_teamctx_p: DEFAULT_CONFIG.hooksに個別keyはなし。workflow・team layerが呼び出す場合のみ意味を持ちます。
ja.s4_hk_uca_p: Usage・context injection hook。settings.jsonテンプレートには含まれていません。
ja.s4_isHookEnabled_p: 見落としやすいポイント：isHookEnabled()はhooks.<name>がfalseのときのみ無効化されます。keyがなければ通常enabledとみなされます。ただし個別のスイッチを持つguardもあります：privacy-blockは旧keyprivacyBlock=falseを読み取り、simplify-gateはsimplify.gate.enabledとENV変数CK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1を持ちます。
ja.s4_h3_manual: 手動でのオン・オフと自己確認
ja.s4_manual_p: 素早く変更するには、対象スコープの.ck.jsonを編集します。keyが明示的に設定されている場合、プロジェクトconfigがグローバルより優先されます。keyがなければinherit・デフォルトに従います。settings.jsonでwire済みのhookに対しては、falseで無効化し、上位スコープで無効化されていた場合はtrueで再有効化できます。以下のHook列のhook名はhooks.<name>で使用するkeyと同じです。
ja.s4_do1_note: hookスクリプトは残りますが、runtimeは通過させます。
ja.s4_do2: グローバルで無効化されたhookを再有効化する
ja.s4_do2_note: ローカルのkeyが明示的にグローバルをoverrideします。
ja.s4_do4: simplify-gateを実際のブロックモードで有効化する
ja.s4_do4_note: simplify.gate.enabled=trueがなければgateのブロックモードは有効になりません。
ja.s4_do5: session・スコープごとにsimplify-gateを無効化する
ja.s4_do6_note: freshインストールはデフォルトでwireされていないため、.ck.jsonの変更だけでは不十分です。
ja.s4_trigger_p: hookがトリガーされるか確認したいときは、ファイル名ではなくlifecycle eventを確認してください。同じhookスクリプトは、settings.jsonのevent・matcherが現在のアクションと一致するときのみ動作します。以下のテーブルは各hookを素早く確認する方法です。not wiredのhookは先にwireするか、スクリプトが対応していれば手動CLIで呼び出す必要があります。

ja.s4_tr_quota: セッションを開く、新しいpromptを送信、またはTask・Todoを更新する。
ja.s4_tr_quota_n: Usageをキャッシュ。hook flagは個別に読み取らない。
ja.s4_tr_simplify: diffが十分大きい状態でship・merge・pr・deploy・publishの意図を持つpromptを送信する。
ja.s4_tr_simplify_n: simplify.gate.enabled=trueが必要。デフォルトはブロックしません。
ja.s4_tr_descname: ClaudeにWriteでファイルを作成させる。
ja.s4_tr_descname_n: PreToolUse(Write)。ファイル名を分かりやすくするよう促します。
ja.s4_tr_scout: Claudeにnode_modules・distを読ませるか、広すぎるglobを使わせる。
ja.s4_tr_privacy: Claudeに.env・keyファイル・secretパスを読ませる。
ja.s4_tr_plan: ClaudeにEdit・Write・MultiEditでplanファイルを編集させる。
ja.s4_tr_plan_n: PostToolUse。フォーマットについて警告。hook flagは個別に読み取らない。
ja.s4_tr_sstate: Task・Todoを更新し、subagentを終了、またはturnを終了する。
ja.s4_tr_wag: UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse(Bash)にwireするか、--stage付きでスクリプトを実行する。
ja.s4_tr_wag_n: freshインストールではhookモードが自動トリガーされません。
ja.s4_tr_taskc_n: TaskCompleted。通常のprompt・toolフローではありません。
ja.s4_tr_idle: Agent TeamsのteammateがI作業を終えてidleになる。
ja.s4_tr_teamctx_n: agent idがteamに所属する場合のみスクリプトが意味を持ちます。

ja.s4_tr_uca_n: usage quota cache refreshのレガシーラッパーです。
ja.s5_tag: Guardグループ · ファイル・パスのブロック
ja.s5_title: scout-block — 不要なディレクトリの読み取りをブロック
ja.s5_p1: エージェントはよくnode_modules/を読んだり、ルートで**/*.tsをglobしたり（globはパスマッチングパターン。**/*.tsはすべてのサブディレクトリのすべての.tsファイルを意味します）、dist/index.jsをcatしたりします。その都度、数万tokenがcontextに詰め込まれ、コストと次のturnの品質を低下させます。scout-block.cjsはPreToolUseを登録し、すべてのRead・Bash・Glob・Grepの前に動作します。
ja.s5_baseline_cmt: # ベースライン .ckignore — pattern-matcher.cjs が処理
ja.s5_allow_p: ビルドコマンドは通過します。npm build、go build、make、docker buildなどのコマンドは、ビルドプロセスがnode_modulesやdistに触れる場合でも実行されます。このグループをブロックすると、CKのship・testフローがビルドステップで自己ブロックしやすくなります。
ja.s5_gap1_t: Gap #1 — hookがクラッシュした場合
ja.s5_gap1_p: Fail-open：parseエラーはすべてexit 0につながり、ツールは通過します。hookにバグがある → その層のguardがサイレントに無効化されます。
ja.s6_tag: Guardグループ · センシティブなファイル・パスのブロック
ja.s6_title: privacy-block — secretをブロックし、ユーザーの明示的な承認を求める
ja.s6_p1: エージェントが.env、id_rsa、*.pem、credentials.yamlに触れると — secretがtranscriptに漏れます。一度contextに入ると、ログに残ったり、reviewer outputに引用されたり、PRにペーストされる可能性があります。
ja.s6_p2: ClaudeはJSONをparseし、AskUserQuestionを呼び出します。ユーザーが承認した場合、hookメッセージは承認済みの方法でファイルを読むよう案内します。例えば確認後にcat ".env"を実行するなど。コードはプレフィックスAPPROVED:もサポートしています。重要な点：明示的なapprovalが必要であり、モデルに同意を自己解釈させません。
ja.s6_gap2_p: privacy-blockはBashを通過させ、警告のみを出します。Bashを実行する権限があれば誰でもapprovalフローなしにsecretを読み取れます。
ja.s6_incident_t: 警告：すでに漏洩した場合
ja.s6_incident_p: Privacy-blockはREADのみをブロックします。すぐにcredentialをrotateし、会話ログを監査し、git historyでsecretがcommitされていないか確認してください。
ja.s7_tag: Guardグループ · 誤ったステップのブロック
ja.s7_title: simplify-gate — diffがスコープを超えて膨らんだときにshipをブロック
ja.s7_p1: 小さなタスクが多数のファイルに触れるPRに膨らむことがあります：バリデーションの修正、cleanupの追加、フォーマット変更、周辺helperの調整。エージェントが「OK ship」と言うとき、simplify-gate.cjsはUserPromptSubmitを登録し、git diff HEADを読み取り、promptに以下のいずれかが含まれる場合のみ評価します：ship merge pr deploy publish。
ja.s7_stats_note: simplify.thresholdのデフォルト値：追加+削除行の合計、変更ファイル数、1ファイル内の最大追加行数。gateがブロックするのはsimplify.gate.enabled=trueの場合のみで、これらの値は.ck.jsonでoverrideできます。
ja.s7_gap3_t: Gap #3 — デフォルトは誤解されやすい
ja.s7_gap3_p: hooks.simplify-gate = trueはClaude Codeがスクリプトを呼び出すことを許可するだけです。スクリプトを実際にPRの肥大化をブロックさせるには、simplify.gate.enabled = trueを追加で有効化する必要があります。freshインストールではこのフラグが有効になっていないため、gateは軽いチェックのみを行いブロックしません。
ja.s7_code_cmt: // プロジェクト .ck.json — 実際に有効化する
ja.s7_p2: matchedSeverity()は"don't ship"を無視し、"ship on"から"ship on Friday"も通過します。あるスコープのすべてのセッションでgateを無効にするには、settings.jsonのenvキーにCK_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1を設定してください。
ja.s8_p1: フルパイプライン → 各フェーズが決定を記録したJSONファイルを残します。各ステップ後の領収書のようなものです。このhookはUserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Bash)にアタッチするよう設計されていますが、freshインストール後のデフォルトのhookセットには含まれておらず、使用するにはopt-inが必要です。
ja.s8_a1: 読み取ったコードスニペット
ja.s8_a2: 高リスクフラグ、自動停止
ja.s8_p2: このgateには2段階の処理があります。ship・push・PR・deployなどのリスクの高いステップでは、hookはフローを即座に停止し、理由をモデルに返せます（emitBlock()）。finalizeやcommitなどの軽いステップでは、hookはフローを続行しながら、モデルが自己修正できるよう警告をcontextに追加します（emitSoft()）。
ja.s8_gap4_p: workflow-artifact-gateは最も強力なartifact検査層ですが、freshインストールでは自動的に呼び出されません。使用するには、settings.jsonでhookをwireし、.ck.jsonでconfigを有効化する必要があります。この手順を省くと、ship・push・PR・deployはgateによってブロックされません。
ja.s9_p1: Hookはtool callのみをブロックします。tool callではなく順序の問題があります：plan前のコーディング、scout前のfix。CKはskill markdownに<HARD-GATE>を組み込んでいます。
ja.s9_p2: ck:cookとck:fixはそれぞれ4つのhard-gate（plan/scout-first、exact-reqまたはroot-cause、no-side-effects）を持ちます。
ja.s9_why_p: 「hard」という言葉は誤解されやすいですが、コードによるブロックではありません。promptの中の指示です。モデルが無視した場合、exit 2でブロックすることはありません。XMLラップは、モデルが近道を正当化しにくくするため、通常のruleより強いシグナルを作ります。
ja.s10_p1: dev-rules-reminder.cjsはUserPromptSubmitを登録し、各promptにrulesテキストをinjectします。ここで明確に区別すべき2つの層があります：hookはcontextをinjectするメカニズムであり、CLAUDE.md内のruleはinjectされるコンテンツです。TTLは(sessionId, baseDir)ごとに5分で、tokenの無駄遣いを防ぎます。

ja.gloss_harness: モデルとマシンの間の調整層：toolコマンドの送信、権限管理、hookの実行を担います。Guard railを組み込む場所です。
ja.gloss_hook: prompt・tool・sessionのライフサイクルの固定タイミングで、検査や状態記録のためにharnessが自動呼び出しする小さなスクリプトです。
ja.gloss_lifecycle: hookが呼び出されるタイミング：UserPromptSubmit（prompt受信時）、PreToolUse（tool前）、PostToolUse（tool後）、Stop/SubagentStop（session・subagent終了時）。
ja.gloss_exitcode: プロセス終了時に返す数値。0は通過、2はブロック、1はエラーだがブロックしません。
ja.gloss_failopen: hookがエラー・クラッシュした場合、harnessはブロックせずにツールの実行を継続します。guardがサイレントに無効化されます。
ja.gloss_transcript: セッションにおけるユーザーとエージェントの会話の全記録。
ja.gloss_context: モデルが推論時に「見ている」情報の領域。不要なファイルで溢れるとコストが上がり、品質が低下します。
ja.gloss_glob: パスマッチングパターン。**/*.ts = すべてのサブディレクトリのすべての.tsファイル。
ja.gloss_secret: センシティブな情報：APIキー、秘密鍵、credential。transcriptへの漏洩はリスクです。
ja.gloss_loc: Lines of code — コードの行数。diffのサイズ測定に使用します。
ja.gloss_artifact: 各フェーズのパイプラインが残すJSONファイルで、次のフェーズが確認できるよう決定を記録します。
ja.closing_title: 正しい層を読み、適切に信頼する
ja.closing_p1: エージェントが広い権限を持つ場合、「CKをインストールすれば安全」とは結論づけないでください。Guard railを信頼する前に、2つの場所を確認してください：settings.jsonがどのhookをwireしているか、.ck.jsonが何を有効・無効にしているか。
ja.closing_p2: 各層はそれぞれ異なるリスクを保護します：hookはtool callをブロックし、ruleは動作を促し、hard-gateはプロセスを維持し、guard skillは呼び出されたときのみ動作します。どの層が動作していて、どの層が単なる指示なのかを把握することで、バグがPRに入り込んでPRODに上がる前に、適切な場所で監査できます。
